title: My Godot 3d attempt turned out disastrous  so I went back to good ole 2d for my upcoming mobile game.
author: Secret_Slide_1357
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1pnpeg8/video/y23n9hcgzg7g1/player

I don't think Godot is ready for vibe coding yet. Maybe soon, but in my opinion, going straight JS engine is what works best. In this case I'm using React as framework.   
  
Assets all created with Gemini pro.  
Workflow is Antigravity with Gemini 3 high  
JS/React/Vite  
This is about 3-4 hours including asset generation. Looking forward to advance this and complete the first level.

comments.author: edoc422
comments.body: how did you make the sprite sheet for your main character in Gemini or what was your process?

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body:
I found existing sprite sheets online and asked gemini to change the character while keeping the exact movement and position.

I then used image editor with a grid to properly place them in a grid.  
That final grid is reused to create different characters in less time.

It's time consuming at first but once you are familiar with process, it's not as bad.

comments.author: sjun0608
comments.body: Could you share some tips for creating background assets?

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body:
Sure this is the prompt I used:

using this character art style, create a seamless horizontally tileable jungle background , with palm trees with militia towers and jeeps.

I uploaded my main character to make sure the style aligned.

comments.author: Available_Brain6231
comments.body: godot and 3d are two words that don't combine and to be real godot is not ready for serious game dev.

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body:
I noticed this is a really polarized discussion.   
To be fair the amount of crashing this software was going through kinda makes me lean in your direction. But then Im a noob too so maybe I was the culprit...

replies.author: Available_Brain6231
replies.body:
I believed the same when I started, but after trying unity I noticed something: the basic stuff works 100% and at 100% of the time.  
I lost coun't of how many times godot crashed just importing a 3d model, something that never happened to me on unity or unreal.  
lmao, I can say this for real and not as a joke, godot is free but I still want my money back.

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body:
Wow lol!   
But yeah you're probably right and that testimony sure sounds convincing!   
I'll definitely keep that in mind.   
Only reason I went to Godot was the MCP capabilities, hopefully unity or unreal gets that sooner than later.
